10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7aefa5ba-8647-44.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Are you a senior analytics leader ready to shape how artificial intelligence advances the field of analytics? 10x Team is seeking a Head of Analytics – AI Trainer to leverage your expertise and help develop cutting-edge AI systems, all in a flexible, project-based role. About Us: 10x Team connects elite professionals with leading AI labs to accelerate innovation in artificial intelligence across diverse domains. We are looking for experienced analytics leaders based in the EU or UK to help train next-generation AI models, ensuring they reflect best analytics practices and deliver real-world value. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated analytics strategies, dashboards, reports, and insights - Assess the accuracy, relevance, and value of AI-driven analytics outputs - Develop real-world case studies and scenarios based on your analytics leadership experience - Create scenario variations that represent various industries, data contexts, and business objectives - Identify gaps or inaccuracies in AI-generated analytics content and provide clear, structured, actionable feedback - Guide AI models to better understand advanced analytics concepts, methodologies, and best practices About You: - Senior leader (Head, Director, or equivalent) in the analytics/data science field with hands-on experience in data analytics, business intelligence, and strategy - Based in the EU or UK - Deep understanding of analytics frameworks, data modeling, KPI development, and data-driven decision making - Analytical, detail-oriented, and skilled in providing clear, constructive feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week and comfortable working asynchronously/remotely Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance roles – 100% remote - Directly influence how AI understands and supports analytics workflows - Access professional development through the 10x Team AI Academy - Collaborate with a dynamic expert community with streamlined onboarding and ongoing support How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help shape the future of AI-powered analytics—apply today! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5a1661a2-0b4d-.title: Talent Development Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5a1661a2-0b4d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Talent Development Specialist based in the United States. This is a hands-on opportunity to help shape learning experiences that enable employees to build skills and perform at their best. You’ll contribute across learning design, content development, program facilitation, LMS administration, and talent development initiatives. The role offers broad exposure to modern learning technologies, including AI-powered tools for creating and enhancing educational content. You’ll collaborate closely with learning specialists, instructional designers, technology partners, and business stakeholders. Success in this position requires strong organization, creativity, attention to detail, and a genuine focus on the learner experience. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and continuous improvement is encouraged. It’s an ideal role for someone eager to grow their expertise across the full talent development lifecycle. Support the development of engaging eLearning modules, job aids, videos, assessments, storyboards, scripts, and other learning materials using adult learning principles. Use AI tools and modern learning technologies to draft, prototype, refine, and enhance content efficiently. Apply established templates, brand guidelines, and accessibility standards to produce consistent, polished learning experiences. Facilitate or co-facilitate flagship learning programs, including new-hire orientation and employee development initiatives, in both virtual and in-person settings. Coordinate program logistics, participant communications, follow-up activities, and feedback collection to deliver a smooth learner experience. Support the learning management system by preparing and deploying learning solutions, maintaining enrollments and records, tracking completion, and generating reports. Manage multiple projects, deadlines, and shifting priorities while keeping stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and support needs. Collaborate with Talent Development, Learning Experience Design, Learning Technology, and business stakeholders on team initiatives and special projects. Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying learner feedback and operational insights that can strengthen future programs. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Adult Learning, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 1–3 years of experience in talent development, corporate learning, instructional design, training facilitation, or a related discipline. Experience developing learning content with modern authoring tools such as Articulate Rise, Storyline, or comparable platforms. Familiarity with multimedia creation tools such as Canva, Loom, Synthesia, or similar solutions. Experience using AI and modern design technologies to support content creation, prototyping, and enhancement. Comfortable facilitating or co-facilitating learning sessions and engaging audiences both virtually and in person. Familiarity with learning management systems, including preparing content for deployment and creating, updating, and running reports. Understanding of adult learning principles, inclusive learning practices, and accessibility standards. Ability to transform complex information into clear, practical, and engaging learning materials. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with stakeholders. Excellent organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and consistently meet deadlines. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, clarity, and an excellent learner experience. Curious, adaptable, proactive, and comfortable learning new subject areas and supporting diverse business functions. Benefits Compensation: $65,000–$80,000 annual on-target earnings, incl

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5d424cd5-4f21-.title: Senior Fintech Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5d424cd5-4f21-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Fintech Engineer based in India. This is a high-impact engineering opportunity focused on building financial infrastructure for complex, high-value, cross-border transactions. You will take ownership of a payment gateway designed to simplify global fund flows, vendor payouts, and milestone-based financial operations. The role combines fintech architecture, distributed systems, payment integrations, security, and financial data integrity. You will work across the stack, moving seamlessly between system design and hands-on implementation. Your work will help create reliable infrastructure capable of supporting significant transaction volumes and high-value payments. The environment favors builders who enjoy solving complex problems, taking technical ownership, and establishing new engineering standards. This is an opportunity to shape a financial platform from the ground up while working with modern cloud and payment technologies. Architect and develop the end-to-end payment gateway, integrating payment and financial service providers such as Stripe Connect and Airwallex to support complex global fund flows. Design and implement milestone-based escrow and ledgering systems capable of securely managing funds throughout extended transaction and planning cycles. Build scalable financial infrastructure for a B2B SaaS platform, enabling businesses to manage cross-border invoicing, payments, and foreign-exchange settlements. Develop reliable backend services and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, Go, or Python within an event-driven architecture. Implement strong security and compliance capabilities, including PCI-DSS and SOC 2 controls as well as automated KYC and AML workflows. Engineer highly reliable systems for high-value financial transactions, targeting 99.99% uptime and strong resilience under periods of exceptionally high demand. Design systems that maintain accurate, consistent, and auditable financial records across payment, ledger, settlement, and payout workflows. Optimize infrastructure and application performance while maintaining security, scalability, and transactional integrity. Translate high-level financial and business requirements into practical technical architecture and production-ready implementations. Establish engineering standards and best practices for payment infrastructure, financial data management, reliability, and security. Requirements 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience within fintech or financial technology environments. Proven experience building and operating scalable financial or payment systems, ideally within organizations working on platforms such as Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex, Checkout.com, or comparable fintech products. Advanced proficiency in Node.js, Go, or Python, with strong experience designing and developing scalable microservices. Deep technical understanding of payment systems and financial concepts, including ledgering, card issuing, 3D Secure 2.0, and cross-border treasury operations. Strong expertise with PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database, particularly for highly consistent and financially sensitive records. Experience with event-driven architecture and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. Familiarity with payment service integrations and APIs, particularly Stripe Connect, Airwallex, or similar providers. Strong understanding of security, compliance, transaction integrity, and reliability requirements within fintech environments. A hands-on builder mindset with the ability to move from architectural design to implementation and troubleshooting. Strong ownership, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in an evolving environment. Experience with React or other modern frontend technologies is a plus. Benefits

Our partner is looking for a Senior Analyst, Trading based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to join a growing trading and operations function in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will manage daily trade activity across multiple brokers, custodians, and product lines while adapting execution strategies to changing market conditions. The position combines hands-on trading with operational oversight, technology support, and continuous process improvement.
